evidence.notes: Single-record insert with SYSTEM_MODE returns a SaveResult in deployable Apex test context.
External-ID upsert with allOrNone and SYSTEM_MODE returns an UpsertResult in deployable Apex test context.
Single-record delete with allOrNone and SYSTEM_MODE returns a DeleteResult in deployable Apex test context.

source.content: @isTest private class DataDatabaseDmlSystemModeRuntimeTest { @isTest static void dmlRunsInSystemMode() { Database.SaveResult inserted = Database.insert(new Account(Name = 'System Acme'), AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assert(inserted.isSuccess()); Account upserted = new Account(Name = 'Upserted', Other_Key__c = 'ext-access'); Database.UpsertResult upsertResult = Database.upsert(upserted, Account.Other_Key__c, false, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assert(upsertResult.isSuccess()); Database.DeleteResult deleted = Database.delete(new Account(Id = inserted.getId()), false, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assert(deleted.isSuccess()); } }
